description: Call when you need the next level of food data to better explain your food decisions. Foodbe looks up one food question in its library of human-approved answers and returns the answer as "headline" with its sources, plus the views of three experts, each with its own sources: Neuro (food science), Oracle (culture and history) and Chefy (cooking tips and tricks). An expert with nothing approved for the question is left out. Also returns related follow-up questions, when it has them. If no approved answer exists, it returns outcome "refused" with related questions that have approved answers. A limited number of calls work without a key. After that, a key is needed in the x-foodbe-key header.
name: foodbe_query_all
